biggest_catch: Must reside in Kern, Kings, Tulare, or Fresno County, California, and the account must be opened online — in-branch openings do not qualify.
catches: Must reside in Kern, Kings, Tulare or Fresno County, California.
Account MUST be opened online; in-branch openings are not eligible.
Use promo code SAFE1! when applying.
Open or hold a regular share savings account with a $5.00 minimum initial deposit.
Within 60 days of account opening: set up recurring direct deposit of $500 or more per month OR complete at least 10 debit card transactions, AND enroll in eDocuments.
No monthly maintenance fee or minimum balance on the checking account itself.
$200 is deposited to the share savings account within 60 days AFTER account opening (payout can lag up to 60 days even after requirements are met).
Bonus posted as a dividend and reported to the IRS on a 1099 form — taxable as interest/dividends.
